title: Narcissin induces developmental toxicity and cardiotoxicity in zebrafish embryos via Nrf2/HO-1 and calcium signaling pathways.
authors: Gao, Shuo; Zhou, Chaoyi; Hou, Linhua; Xu, Kuo; Zhang, Yun; Wang, Xue; Li, Jianheng; Liu, Kechun; Xia, Qing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然黄酮类化合物Narcissin对斑马鱼胚胎的发育毒性和心脏毒性，涉及Nrf2/HO-1和钙信号通路，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法无关。
abstract: Narcissin is a natural flavonoid from some edible and traditional medicinal plants. It has been proven to have multiple biological functions and exhibits potential therapeutic effects on hypertension, cancer, and Alzheimer's disease. However, the toxicity of narcissin is largely unknown. Here, we revealed that narcissin treatment led to reduced hatchability, increased malformation rate, shorter body length, and slowed blood flow in zebrafish. Furthermore, bradycardia, pericardial edema, increased SV-BA distance, diminished stroke volume, ejection fraction, and ventricular short-axis shortening rate were also found. A large accumulation of ROS, increased apoptotic cells, and histopathological changes were detected in the heart region. Moreover, the gene expression profiles and molecular docking analysis indicated that Nrf2/HO-1 and calcium signaling pathways were involved in narcissin-induced toxicity. In conclusion, here we provide the first evidence that demonstrates narcissin-induced developmental toxicity and cardiotoxicity in zebrafish via Nrf2/HO-1 and calcium signaling pathways for the first time.
abstract_zh: Narcissin是一种来自某些食用和传统药用植物的天然黄酮类化合物。已证明其具有多种生物功能，并对高血压、癌症和阿尔茨海默病表现出潜在的治疗效果。然而，narcissin的毒性在很大程度上尚不清楚。在此，我们揭示了narcissin处理导致斑马鱼孵化率降低、畸形率增加、体长缩短和血流减慢。此外，还观察到心动过缓、心包水肿、SV-BA距离增加、每搏输出量、射血分数和心室短轴缩短率降低。在心脏区域检测到大量ROS积累、凋亡细胞增加和组织病理学变化。此外，基因表达谱和分子对接分析表明，Nrf2/HO-1和钙信号通路参与了narcissin诱导的毒性。总之，我们在此首次提供证据，证明narcissin通过Nrf2/HO-1和钙信号通路诱导斑马鱼的发育毒性和心脏毒性。
